hypothesis: When Binance top traders' POSITION ratio leans away from the all-accounts ratio (relative to the last 30 days), the large accounts are informed; following the divergence over the next 8 hours beats side-matched random twins on BTC and ETH.
closed_ideas_check: Not on CLOSED_IDEAS. G2 (closed, FAIL) faded the top-trader ACCOUNT ratio alone; this follows the difference between the top-trader POSITION ratio and the all-accounts ratio, the opposite stance on a different series pair (both count against the Bonferroni budget, batch2.md). K3 used taker volume flow, not positioning.
data_choice: Binance UM metrics 5m (Features.metrics, avail = stamp + 300): sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio and count_long_short_ratio. Same rows as G2, inside the 2020-01 -> 2024-06 train block.

rules.grid_times: decision on each 1m bar whose close is a UTC 4h boundary; t_dec = bar close (as G2).
rules.sample: for each column: latest value with avail <= t_dec and age <= 900 s; x = ln(value); NaN if missing or <= 0 (NaN occupies its window slot).
rules.z: each column z-scored separately against its previous 180 grid samples (30 days), >= 150 valid, ddof 1, current excluded.
rules.signal: d = z_top_position - z_all_accounts; |d| >= D -> side = sign(d) (follow the large accounts). Either z NaN -> no trade.
rules.bracket: stop = target = 1.5% of the decision close; time exit 8h after entry; one trade at a time (engine).

count_check: signals only, count-only train look, non-overlapping count at the 8h time exit (as F7/G2); configs under 200 on BTC or ETH dropped, not replaced.
expected_sign: positive mean net R on BTC and ETH; D = 2.0 not weaker than D = 1.0.
against_the_mechanism: Report only (not gated, not in the budget): top-trader-only control, series = 'top_only', side = sign(z_top_position) when |z_top_position| >= D, same bracket, on the configs that ran. If it does as well as the divergence (mean net R within 0.02R or better), the retail leg adds nothing.
